title: What Is Consumer Directed Services (CDS) in Missouri? You're the Boss
short_title: What is Consumer Directed Services (CDS)? You're the boss
description: In Missouri's Consumer Directed Services (CDS) program, the person who needs care chooses their own caregiver, often a family member or friend, and Medicaid pays them. Here's who qualifies, what help is covered, what being the employer takes, and what we handle for you.
end: CDS is free for Missouri Medicaid participants.

parts.head: What is Consumer Directed Services?
parts.sub: You're the boss. Here's what that means.
parts.text: What is CDS? In Missouri's Consumer Directed Services program, the person who needs care is the boss. I'm Samantha with Caring Companions CDS. Here's what that really means, and why so many families choose it.

parts.head: Who qualifies
parts.sub: 18+, active Missouri Medicaid, needs help, lives at home
parts.text: First, who qualifies. You need to be eighteen or older, have active Missouri Medicaid, need help with daily activities like bathing, dressing, meals or getting around, and live in your own home, not a nursing home.

parts.head: What the caregiver helps with
parts.sub: Bathing, dressing, meals, housekeeping, laundry, errands
parts.text: The caregiver helps with the tasks in your plan of care. That can include bathing, dressing and grooming, making meals, light housekeeping and laundry, and errands and grocery shopping.

parts.head: You choose who comes
parts.sub: Often someone you already know and trust
parts.text: So how is this different from regular home care? With a home care agency, the agency hires the caregiver. In CDS, you choose. Most people choose someone they already know and trust, like a son or daughter, a grandchild, or a friend.

parts.head: Your caregiver works for you
parts.sub: You choose, set the schedule, and can end it
parts.text: In CDS, your caregiver legally works for you. Not for the state, and not for us. That's what gives you the right to choose who comes into your home, set the schedule, and end the arrangement if it isn't working.

parts.head: What being the employer takes
parts.sub: Hire, set the schedule, orient, confirm hours each week
parts.text: So what does being the employer actually take? You choose who you hire. You set the schedule within your authorized hours. You orient your caregiver when they start. And each week, you confirm the recorded hours, so payday is on time.

parts.head: What we take off your plate
parts.sub: Tax setup, payroll, quarterly returns, W-2s, screening
parts.text: And here's what we take off your plate: both tax registrations, payroll, tax withholding and deposits, the quarterly returns, the W-2s at the end of the year, and the background screening. You never file a payroll form yourself.

parts.head: Orient your caregiver
parts.sub: 8 topics. Twenty minutes now saves arguments later.
parts.text: About that orientation. Missouri asks you to go over eight topics with your caregiver, like the tasks in your plan, how you like things done, recording time honestly, and who to call in an emergency. Even if your caregiver is your own daughter, do it anyway. Twenty minutes now saves a lot of arguments later.

parts.head: Your employer numbers are yours
parts.sub: Switch agencies, and they go with you
parts.text: Here's a quiet advantage. Your two employer tax numbers belong to you, not to us. So if you ever switch CDS agencies, they go with you, and your care keeps going.

parts.head: Not every agency pays the same
parts.sub: With us: $15 to $16 an hour, every Thursday
parts.text: And not every CDS agency pays caregivers the same. With us, your caregiver earns fifteen to sixteen dollars an hour, paid every Thursday.

parts.head: We help you meet caregivers
parts.text: Don't have anyone to be your caregiver? Our private directory, Find CDS Caregivers, lets you see local caregivers and ask to meet the ones you like. You still choose who you hire.

Approved CDS services are paid for through Missouri Medicaid. To see if you qualify, take the two-minute check at caringcds.com, or call us at 417-218-2888. I'm Samantha with Caring Companions CDS. Thanks for watching.
